name: k-pi-monorepo
description: K-π: a first-party graph-engineered coding agent harness, forked from Pi

scripts.build: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && npm run build && cd ../../protocol && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.build:offline: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build:offline && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && npm run build && cd ../../protocol && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.check: biome check --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && tsc --noEmit && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:kpi && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
